title: MXLA Hardware Triage Workflow
description: General multi-slice MXLA hardware fault isolation SOP workflow for tracing TPU execution hangs across any topology size to uncorrectable HBM ECC memory faults and bad host instances. Reference [[kueue-stuck-termination-recovery]] playbook if jobs get stuck in termination due to RIP repair. If OOM during compilation: run maxtext.trainers.pre_train.train_compile offline and pass compile_xla_flags='--xla_dump_to=/tmp/xla_dump/ --xla_dump_hlo_as_text=True' to dump HLO locally.
